note.question: How should a manufacturer allocate inventory risk through preorder or consignment when a retailer's degree of risk aversion is private and an uncertain outside opportunity affects participation?
note.overview: This is a principal–agent screening model with IC/IR constraints; the equilibrium language is separating versus pooling contracts rather than a generic BNE label.

models.method: With a game-theoretic model that captures the interaction among risk aversion, information asymmetry, and outside opportunity, we derive the contracting equilibrium under two widely adopted risk allocation schemes—push (i.e., the retailer bears the inventory risk) and pull (i.e., the manufacturer bears the inventory risk) contracts.
